entries.description: The RFC 9727 linkset for the public announcements API — the Mission Log and the roadmap — pointing at its OpenAPI description and its human documentation.
representativeQueries: what is the latest UniverLab announcement
is there a public API for the UniverLab mission log
where can I read the UniverLab roadmap

entries.description: The Agent Skills Discovery index (RFC v0.2.0): every skill UniverLab publishes, with its URL and a SHA-256 digest of the bytes actually served.
representativeQueries: which agent skills does UniverLab publish
how do I get the canopy skill
what can an agent do with UniverLab skills

entries.description: The plain-language index of the whole site: what UniverLab is, every experiment, and every documentation page in markdown.

The MCP Server Card for the UniverLab remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP at https://univerlab.org/mcp): four read-only tools over the lab's roadmap, Mission Log, about text and mission-date translator.
representativeQueries: what is on the UniverLab roadmap
how do I convert a UniverLab mission date
connect to the UniverLab MCP server
